title: To those who can fly have you tried reaching space?
content: One time I tried finding "the edge" and flew into space, there were these long (massive) cables that looked like l.e.d light tubes in the distance. When I reached one and grabbed hold of it I was somehow transported to an old office building, like when I turned my head I was already there and the cable remained running along the wall. It was a regular office building with a lot of filing cabinets full of papers, a janitor closet, standard stuff. I won't go into detail about what happened next but I ran into some people who seemed to know what was going on and they basically tricked me into going back "to sleep". Just curious if there are any other space stories.
